paragraphs.text: Troop 12 is asking Scouts, former members, families and friends to RSVP by Friday, Nov. 20, for its 100th anniversary gathering at Trace State Park in Pontotoc County. The celebration begins at 2 p.m. Saturday, Dec. 5.

The troop says December will be its 905th consecutive month of camping. Scouts will have a designated camping area. Alumni, relatives and friends can camp, too, or join the afternoon festivities without staying overnight.

Guests planning to eat with the troop can reserve dinner for $17 per person. A commemorative patch costs $10. The registration form asks guests to enter quantities even if they plan to pay at the gathering so organizers know how much food to order.

The park lists its entrance at 2139 Faulkner Road, Belden. Drivers coming from the Natchez Trace Parkway can follow Mississippi 6/U.S. 278 west to Faulkner Road, then continue two miles to the park office. The state cautions that navigation apps may otherwise send visitors down narrow dirt roads.
